description:
Activate Moonscarred Werewolf by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Moonscarred Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Moonscarred Werewolf.
Repeat.

uses.name: Scorned Villager // Moonscarred Werewolf
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Moonscarred Werewolf and without summoning sickness
